black-giant.text:
EnergyX describes the Black Giant project at Salar de Punta Negra, Antofagasta, Chile across 100,000+ acres.

EnergyX publishes a planned capacity of 53Ktpa LCE† for the project.

The company states an in-situ resource estimate of 9.8M tonnes LCE†.

Source: EnergyX's public pages.

† Planned and estimated figures describe goals or projections. They may change, or may not happen. Each one links to the page it was taken from.

water.text:
Conventional lithium extraction consumes up to 400,000 gallons per ton (also published as 500K gallons water/ton lithium).

EnergyX publishes around 800 gallons per ton for its process, which the company describes as a freshwater reduction of over 90%.

Source: EnergyX's public pages.

dle.text:
Conventional lithium extraction uses up to 400,000 gallons per ton (also published as 500K gallons water/ton lithium), while EnergyX DLE uses around 800 gallons per ton.

EnergyX describes this as a freshwater reduction of over 90%.

EnergyX publishes a processing time of Days (also published as Hours) (also published as hours to days) (also published as 1-2 days).

Source: EnergyX's public pages.
